## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no functional change
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — adding/adjusting tests only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling, build, CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the layer boundaries in `docs/architecture.md` (no
      `domain/` → `infrastructure/` imports, etc.)
- [ ] Public functions/classes have type hints and docstrings
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally (`make test`)
- [ ] `make lint`, `make format-check`, and `make typecheck` pass locally
- [ ] Relevant docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/*.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] If this touches cryptography or the wire protocol, `docs/security.md`
      and/or `docs/protocol.md` are updated accordingly
- [ ] New architecture/technology decisions are recorded as an ADR in
      `docs/adr/`
